name: Omnichannel Orchestration & Context Sharing
description: Cross-channel session continuity and state hydration fabric governing canonical Context Envelopes, deterministic and probabilistic identity stitching across anonymous and authenticated touchpoints, seamless modality switching (web and mobile app to voice via SIP UUI and signed JWT session tokens, voice to SMS and visual IVR deflection, asynchronous to synchronous escalation), warm handoff state contracts, slot and intent ledger hydration, and channel parity governance.
roleInCenter: Continuity fabric: preserves verified customer identity, intent stack, extracted slots, and conversation history across every channel transition and escalation so customers never repeat themselves.

glossary.definition: Standardized, cryptographically signed JSON state payload propagated across channel switches, bot-to-bot delegations, and live agent escalations containing identity claims, verified authentication assurance, active intent stack, extracted slot ledger, transcript digest, and consent flags

Real-time identity resolution process that merges anonymous digital device telemetry, browser session tokens, messaging handles, and telephony ANI into a unified CRM customer profile and active journey instance

Controlled transition of an active interaction from a lower-bandwidth or asynchronous modality (such as web browse, mobile app, or SMS) to a higher-bandwidth synchronous modality (such as live voice or co-browse) while retaining full session state

glossary.term: SIP UUI & Call Header Token Binding
glossary.definition: Telephony signaling mechanism that embeds a compact Context Envelope reference token or signed session identifier inside SIP User-to-User Information (UUI) or X-headers during PSTN and WebRTC call setup so the receiving IVR and ACD hydrate prior digital context immediately

Schema-enforced transfer agreement between a sending channel or virtual agent and a receiving queue or human agent that guarantees verified authentication status, summarized problem statement, completed troubleshooting steps, and unfilled slot requirements arrive before media connection

Runtime pre-population of a receiving bot or agent desktop with the hierarchical intent stack and typed entity slots (such as order number, disputed amount, or travel date) already extracted in upstream channels

Long-lived conversation state management allowing customers to pause an interaction on SMS, WhatsApp, or in-app messaging and resume hours or days later with full thread context, slot memory, and dynamic queue re-entry

Multimodal synchronization bridge that pairs an active voice call with a real-time mobile web view, visual IVR card, or authenticated co-browse session for complex form completion, document upload, or visual seat selection

Short-lived, cryptographically verifiable claim inside the Context Envelope certifying the NIST or enterprise Assurance Level (IAL and AAL) achieved in the originating mobile app or web session so the receiving voice IVR or live agent skips redundant security questioning

Architectural governance ensuring that business rules, policy guardrails, CRM mutations, and customer-visible transaction statuses remain consistent whether the customer interacts via mobile app, web chat, SMS, or voice

Chronological, cross-modality interaction ledger that stitches together web clickstreams, virtual agent turns, SMS notifications, and voice call summaries into a single continuous thread visible to both customer and agent

Runtime dialog and agent-desktop enforcement rule that suppresses IVR prompts, bot slot questions, and agent verification scripts for any attribute already present and verified in the active Context Envelope

facets.name: Context Envelope & Payload Facets
facets.description: Structural layers of the canonical Omnichannel Context Envelope propagated across channel switches and escalations

children.name: Identity & Authentication Claims Layer
children.description: Verified customer identity keys and security assurance claims carried across channels

children.name: Canonical Customer & Account Party ID
children.description: Resolved master CRM customer identifier and active account or household scope

children.name: Authentication Assurance & Biometric Claim
children.description: Signed attestation of completed OAuth, passkey, device biometric, or voiceprint verification

children.name: Token TTL & High-Risk Scope Binding
children.description: Expiration window and transaction scope limits governing whether high-risk actions require re-verification

children.name: Intent Stack & Slot Ledger Layer
children.description: Structured semantic state of what the customer is trying to accomplish and parameters already provided

children.name: Active & Suspended Intent Stack
children.description: Ordered stack of primary customer intent, nested sub-intents, and confidence scores across multi-intent sessions

children.name: Validated Entity & Slot Ledger
children.description: Typed, schema-validated entities (dates, order IDs, dollar amounts, error codes) with source provenance

children.name: Failed Self-Service & API Attempt Log
children.description: Record of workflow steps or backend tool calls already attempted and their failure reasons to prevent re-running dead paths

children.name: Interaction Digest, Telemetry & Governance Layer
children.description: Summarized history, digital struggle breadcrumbs, and regulatory consent state

children.name: Structured Conversation & Sentiment Digest
children.description: Concise abstractive summary, customer sentiment trajectory, and key commitments made prior to handoff

children.name: Web & Mobile Screen Breadcrumb Trail
children.description: Last N screens viewed, form validation errors, cart contents, and rage-click telemetry preceding contact initiation

children.name: Recording Consent, Privacy & Suppression Flags
children.description: Active TCPA, GDPR, PCI redaction, and recording consent states governing downstream channels

facets.name: Cross-Channel Modality Transitions
facets.description: Directional switching patterns between digital, messaging, and voice modalities

children.name: Digital-to-Voice Elevation (Web or App to Voice)
children.description: Escalating from authenticated web or mobile app sessions into live or automated voice without context loss

children.name: In-App WebRTC Contextual Voice Call
children.description: Direct VoIP call launched inside the mobile app with signed JWT Context Envelope attached to SIP INVITE headers

children.name: PSTN Click-to-Call & Scheduled Callback Binding
children.description: Reserves a short-lived context token matched by outbound callback or inbound ANI plus one-time passkey

children.name: Voice-to-Digital Deflection & Multimodal Sync
children.description: Shifting bandwidth-heavy or visually complex tasks from voice to messaging or mobile web

children.name: IVR-to-SMS & Messaging Deflection Pivot
children.description: Transfers a caller waiting in queue or navigating IVR into an authenticated SMS, RCS, or WhatsApp thread with state intact

children.name: Simultaneous Voice & Visual Card Co-Browsing
children.description: Maintains live voice audio while pushing interactive visual forms, maps, or document capture to the caller smartphone

children.name: Asynchronous-to-Synchronous Escalation
children.description: Elevating store-and-forward threads into real-time conversational handling

children.name: Async Messaging to Live Agent or Voice Bridge
children.description: seamlessly elevates an asynchronous messaging thread or email case into a live synchronous chat or voice call

children.name: Frontline Bot to Specialist Agent Handoff
children.description: Delegates specialized resolution steps across autonomous agents or human tier-2 queues using unified context envelopes

facets.name: Identity Resolution & Session Continuity
facets.description: Mechanisms correlating customer identity and thread state across disparate channel identifiers and time gaps

children.name: Deterministic Identity & Token Binding
children.description: Exact-match identity correlation backed by cryptographic tokens or verified credentials

children.name: Signed OAuth & JWT Session Claim
children.description: Cryptographically signed session assertion linking authenticated mobile or web state directly to contact arrival

children.name: Verified ANI & Messaging Handle Registry
children.description: Matches carrier-attested phone numbers (STIR and SHAKEN) or verified WhatsApp and Apple Business Chat IDs to CRM party records

children.name: Probabilistic & Ephemeral Handoff Correlation
children.description: Fallback correlation when customers cross unauthenticated or out-of-band channels

children.name: Temporal Web-Abandon to Inbound-ANI Match
children.description: Correlates an inbound call arriving within seconds of an authenticated web error on the same customer profile

children.name: Ephemeral 6-Digit Session Bridge Code
children.description: Displays a short-lived numeric code on a web screen that the caller speaks or enters in IVR to bind anonymous web state

children.name: Long-Horizon Thread & Journey Persistence
children.description: Maintaining continuity across hours or days of asynchronous customer pauses

children.name: Multi-Day Open Issue Thread Binding
children.description: Automatically attaches returning contacts within an active resolution window to the open journey instance and prior agent affinity

children.name: Outbound Notification Reply Stitching
children.description: Links a customer SMS reply or inbound call directly to the specific proactive outage, billing, or delivery notification that triggered it

facets.name: Handoff Execution & Hydration Modes
facets.description: Operational patterns governing how context is delivered and consumed when transferring between bots, channels, and human agents

children.name: Cold Blind Transfer (Degraded Anti-Pattern)
children.description: Media-only transfer where signaling drops the Context Envelope, forcing re-authentication and problem restatement

children.name: Warm Screen-Pop & Slot Hydration Handoff
children.description: Pre-delivers the Context Envelope to the receiving ACD queue and agent co-pilot workspace prior to media answer

children.name: Pre-Answer Co-Pilot Briefing Card
children.description: Renders a 3-bullet intent, sentiment, and verified-slot digest on the agent desktop during contact ring or reservation

children.name: IVR Menu & Auth Bypass Hydration
children.description: Fast-forwards the caller past root IVR menus and ID verification directly into the target skill queue using envelope claims

children.name: Whisper-Briefed & Co-Pilot Shadowed Transition
children.description: Interactive handoff where AI or sending specialist briefs the receiving resource and validates continuity

children.name: AI Whisper Audio & Transcript Bridge
children.description: Synthesizes a concise spoken or visual whisper briefing to the receiving agent before bridging the customer audio

children.name: Post-Handoff Co-Pilot Auto-Fill & Guard
children.description: Pre-fills CRM wrap-up fields and alerts the live agent in real time if they ask a question already answered in the envelope

metrics.name: Context Envelope Hydration Success Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of cross-channel switches and bot-to-agent escalations where the full Context Envelope (identity, auth claim, intent stack, and extracted slots) is intact and rendered at the receiving endpoint before first turn

metrics.name: Zero-Repetition Customer Experience Rate
metrics.definition: Share of escalated or channel-switched contacts in which speech and text analytics verify the customer was never asked to repeat verified identity or previously stated slot values

metrics.name: Context-Hydrated Escalation Handle Time
metrics.definition: Average live-agent handle time on cross-channel or bot-escalated contacts arriving with a populated Context Envelope, reflecting time saved on re-authentication and discovery

metrics.name: Omnichannel Seamless Resolution Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of contacts that pivot across two or more modalities (such as mobile app to voice or IVR to SMS) and achieve full issue resolution without subsequent repeat contacts

metrics.name: Voice-to-Digital Modality Pivot Containment Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of voice callers accepting an SMS, visual IVR, or mobile app modality pivot who complete their transaction digitally without returning to the voice queue

metrics.name: Cross-Channel State Synchronization Latency
metrics.definition: P95 end-to-end latency required to persist, transmit, and hydrate the Context Envelope when switching from one channel or agent to another

failureModes.name: Omnichannel Handoff Context Amnesia
failureModes.signal: Customers escalating from web chat or voicebot to a live agent are greeted with 'How can I help you today?' and forced to restate their entire issue; CSAT on escalated contacts drops sharply
failureModes.mitigation: Enforce mandatory Warm Handoff State Contracts in ACD routing and auto-pop the structured Handoff Digest and filled slots inside the agent co-pilot before call answer

failureModes.name: Cross-Channel Re-Authentication Loop
failureModes.signal: Callers initiating contact from an already-authenticated mobile banking or healthcare app are challenged again by IVR and live agents for date of birth, PIN, or KBA
failureModes.mitigation: Propagate signed Authentication Assurance Carryover Tokens via WebRTC headers or SIP UUI and configure IVR and desktop flows to honor valid AAL claims within their TTL window

failureModes.name: Carrier SIP Trunk UUI & Header Stripping
failureModes.signal: Voice calls transferred across PSTN interconnect or regional SBC boundaries arrive at the ACD with empty UUI headers and orphaned Context Envelope lookups
failureModes.mitigation: Implement dual-path context resolution combining RFC-compliant SIP UUI transport with out-of-band cloud session ledger lookup keyed by ANI, DNIS, and sub-second arrival window

failureModes.name: Stale Context & Zombie Slot Overwrite
failureModes.signal: Returning customer starting a new inquiry has their current session polluted by slots (such as an old order ID or travel date) from a resolved ticket days earlier
failureModes.mitigation: Attach strict domain-specific TTLs and journey-disposition lifecycle hooks to every slot in the Context Envelope, archiving closed-intent slots upon resolution

failureModes.name: Split-Brain Simultaneous Channel Collision
failureModes.signal: Customer sends an SMS reply while simultaneously calling into the voice queue, resulting in two agents or bots working conflicting mutations on the same case
failureModes.mitigation: Maintain an atomic distributed session lock on the Unified Conversation Thread Ledger so active synchronous voice handling pauses automated async bot turns and merges both streams into one workspace

failureModes.name: Dead-End Voice-to-Digital Deflection Link
failureModes.signal: Caller accepts an IVR-to-SMS deflection link, clicks the URL, and lands on a generic login page or unhydrated web home screen, triggering immediate angry repeat calls
failureModes.mitigation: Bind deflection deep links to pre-authenticated, single-use session continuity tokens that open directly into the target workflow step with all IVR-captured slots pre-filled

scoringModel.name: Omnichannel Context Continuity & Handoff Rubric
scoringModel.note: Evaluates the end-to-end fidelity of cross-channel modality transitions and bot-to-human escalations across authentication preservation, slot hydration, zero customer repetition, transition speed, and summary grounding.

dimensions.name: Identity & Authentication Assurance Carryover
dimensions.description: Preservation of resolved CRM customer identity and verified authentication assurance level across channel switches without redundant security challenges
sampleCriteria: Customer party ID and account context resolved automatically upon arrival
Valid upstream mobile or web authentication assurance token honored without re-prompting
Step-up verification triggered only when transaction risk exceeds current assurance claim

dimensions.name: Intent Stack & Validated Slot Hydration
dimensions.description: Completeness and accuracy of active intent hierarchy, extracted entity slots, and prior tool execution outcomes hydrated into the receiving channel or desktop
sampleCriteria: All upstream-extracted slots pre-populated in receiving workflow or agent desktop
Primary and nested customer intents preserved across modality pivot
Prior failed self-service attempts logged so receiving resource does not repeat dead-end steps

dimensions.name: Zero-Repetition Customer Experience
dimensions.description: Elimination of redundant IVR menus, duplicate bot slot prompts, and repetitive live-agent discovery questions
sampleCriteria: IVR root menus bypassed when intent is already known from digital click-to-call
Receiving agent greets customer with explicit acknowledgment of their stated issue
Zero questions asked for information already present in the Context Envelope

dimensions.name: Modality Transition & Hydration Speed
dimensions.description: Sub-second technical synchronization of the Context Envelope and seamless media continuity during channel switches
sampleCriteria: Context Envelope hydrated on agent desktop prior to media connection
Voice-to-SMS or visual co-browse link delivered and active within 2 seconds
Asynchronous thread resumption restores full history with zero noticeable lag

dimensions.name: Handoff Digest & Provenance Fidelity
dimensions.description: Conciseness, factual grounding, and actionability of the conversation digest and sentiment trajectory presented to the receiving resource
sampleCriteria: Handoff summary accurately reflects customer problem, sentiment, and promises made
Digital struggle breadcrumbs clearly highlight exact screen or error code encountered
Wrap-up disposition and timeline updates persist back to the unified conversation ledger

stateVariables.description: Continuous K-dimensional context fidelity vector tracking real-time retention of verified identity, authentication assurance, intent hierarchy, and slot values across time and modality switches
Domain-specific exponential decay constant governing half-life expiration of ephemeral authentication tokens, transient error breadcrumbs, and time-sensitive slot claims
Normalized Shannon mutual information ratio between originating session state X_0 and hydrated endpoint state X_t after channel transition or bot-to-human escalation
Continuous control impulse injected via SIP UUI headers, WebRTC JWT claims, or desktop co-pilot hydration streams to restore decayed or dropped context dimensions
Distributed state-vector divergence norm across concurrent multi-region replicas during simultaneous voice and asynchronous digital customer interactions

differentialEquations.name: Continuous Context Fidelity Decay & Hydration SDE
differentialEquations.formula: dF_k(t) = ( -lambda_k * F_k(t) + u_hyd,k(t) * (1 - F_k(t)) ) * dt - gamma_switch * F_k(t) * dN_switch(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Each context dimension k decays exponentially at rate lambda_k during asynchronous pauses, suffers discrete drop loss gamma_switch on unhydrated channel switches dN_switch(t), and is actively restored toward 1.0 by continuous hydration impulse u_hyd,k(t)

differentialEquations.name: Modality Handoff Mutual Information Retention
differentialEquations.formula: I_ret(t) = I(X_0 ; X_t) * inv(H(X_0)) = exp( -integral_0^t ( lambda_eff(s) - C_bridge(s) ) ds )
differentialEquations.interpretation: Quantifies zero-repetition continuity as the ratio of preserved mutual information I(X_0; X_t) to initial customer state entropy H(X_0), bounded by signaling bridge capacity C_bridge(s) (such as SIP UUI payload limits versus full cloud envelope hydration)

differentialEquations.name: Distributed CRDT Thread Ledger Convergence
differentialEquations.interpretation: Guarantees strong eventual consistency across concurrent voice, SMS, and mobile app mutations with exponential convergence rate mu_sync exceeding stochastic multi-channel write arrival noise sigma_write

scaleInvariants: O(1) constant-time Context Envelope lookup and sub-15ms hydration P99 across 10,000,000+ concurrent omnichannel sessions via partitioned in-memory CRDT state shards
Monotonic semilattice slot-merge idempotency ensuring out-of-order webhook, SIP, and async messaging arrivals converge deterministically without distributed lock contention
Zero-repetition information bound: whenever I_ret(t) >= 0.95 at handoff, downstream dialog policies provably suppress 100% of redundant identity and slot prompts
